# Template System

## Purpose

Templates help teams start common migration, validation, agent workflow, code conversion, and report patterns quickly.

## Template Types

- Migration templates
- Validation templates
- Agent workflow templates
- Code conversion templates
- Report templates

## MVP Model

MVP templates should be static JSON/YAML files stored in the repository or local template directory. They should be easy to inspect, version, and apply.

## Initial Template Ideas

- Oracle to Snowflake
- SQL Server to Databricks
- SAS to Databricks
- Python ETL to Databricks Notebook
- SQL Jobs to dbt Models
- Airflow DAG Review
- DataStage Migration Planning
- Generic Source to Target Validation

## Marketplace Later

A future marketplace may support discovery, install, versioning, and validation of templates. Marketplace support is outside MVP.
